title: I Built 40+ Claude Skills With This 1 Simple Plugin
description:
Comment “Skill” for the SkillSmith YouTube vid & repo link

Still stuck trying to build an AI agent?

Anthropic already told you: stop chasing agents, build skills.

A skill IS the agent.
Named worker. Its own tools, routing, and a plain text brain you can read.

SkillSmith scaffolds the whole anatomy with one command.

Run /skillsmith, hit discover, it interviews you.

40+ skills. 10 minutes each. Perfect format every time.

#AIAgent
